title: Critique: panexperientialism is no form of physicalism

statements.text: Physicalism is ontological physicalism, supervenience on the physical, and causal closure of the physical. Panexperientialism, which gives basic constituents a mental pole, is inconsistent with each, and it is not classic emergentism either, so calling it physicalism misleads.

sources.quote: I am inclined to think it misleading to regard panexperientialism as any form of physicalism.
